Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• New items: Help and feedback (Telegram group, write to the developer, guide) and Updates (automatic check, check now).
• Stopwatch and timer can say the time every 1 to 60 seconds, also on the lock screen (Clock settings).
• Volume keys have their own actions for the lock screen.
• The translator keys list names Grok (xAI) and Groq (Llama) differently.
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
